problems.stem: An AI detector says your own essay was AI-written. What kind of error is this?
problems.explanation: Flagging genuine work as AI-generated is a false positive.

problems.stem: Which question best checks whether a tool works for your group?
options: Was it tested on people like the ones it will be used on, with results reported by group?
Does it use the newest model?
problems.explanation: Test populations and disaggregated results show who the tool works for.

options: A person glances at the output after the decision is made.
A person with authority reviews outputs, can override them and is accountable.
The tool has a warning label.
problems.explanation: Oversight requires authority, information and accountability.
